Need a moment to deeply focus on a task? Aero perfectly supports such focus rooms away from open space. It’s also a great fit for a home office when a regular, space-consuming desk isn’t an option.

name: Aimo
sourceDescription:
Guarantee of comfort and ergonomics Aimo swivel chair was designed with everyday comfort in mind. It combines timeless form with functionality, supporting concentration both in the office and at home. Choosing Aimo means choosing a reliable seating solution with an elegant finish. Two models to choose from – with or without a headrest Lumbar support that can be adjusted in height and depth and tilt angle Mesh backrest Comfortable, upholstered seat Backrest recline mechanism with 3 recline positions – from fully reclined to upright Adjustable backrest height and seat depth (to fit your height) Universal black colour Adjustable armrest height Multifunctional castors with an automatic braking mechanism Anti-Shock function

The ability to adjust the seat depth, as well as the height of the backrest and the chair itself, ensures an ergonomic sitting position regardless of body shape. Three-way adjustment of the lumbar support (for height, depth and angle) allows precise adaptation to the body shape and reduces back tension. The upholstered seat and multi-purpose castors with an automatic braking mechanism make it easy to take a safe and comfortable position at your desk.

Thanks to the three-position backrest lock, it is easy to switch from a posture requiring concentration to a more relaxed one. This prevents the chair from leaning back too much or being too stiff. The settings include a stable upright position, an intermediate one and full freedom of movement. In a fully reclined position using a knob, the user can adjust the amount of pressure required to recline the backrest.

Model with a headrest

A comfortable headrest made from the same breathable mesh as the backrest ensures a coherent look and a high level of comfort, providing necessary support. By adjusting the height and angle, the user can position the headrest to suit their needs. The 4D armrests offer a wide range of settings–including armrest height, as well as rotation of the armrest pad and its movement forwards and backwards, and left and right. These features help to reduce tension in the upper body. 4D armrests are available only in model with a headrest.

name: Airi
sourceDescription:
Designed for the rhythm of modern work - whether in a hybrid office, a bustling coworking space, or a quiet home office - Airi represents simplicity and comfort. The defining feature of this model is the “full mesh” experience. With breathable mesh applied to both the seat and the backrest, excellent airflow and thermal comfort are ensured throughout the entire workday. The integrated mechanism allows the chair to follow natural movements smoothly, offering the freedom to rock back for a moment of relaxation or to lock the backrest in a focused working position. With an ergonomic profile that naturally supports the spine and a minimalist, clean aesthetic, Airi serves as a stylish addition to any interior. Monochromatic design: Base, mesh, frame, and armrests all share a single, unified colour. Ergonomic support: Contoured mesh backrest for spinal health. Tilt mechanism: Allows for smooth reclining and a relaxing rocking function. Height adjustment Comfortable armrests

Colour reimagined Airi takes a monochromatic approach to design. The colour of the five-star base is perfectly matched to the mesh, frame and armrests, creating a seamless, uniform look. This makes the chair more than just a tool - it becomes a stylish accent piece for the workspace. Whether in a vibrant shade to boost energy or a muted tone for classic elegance, the chair adds character to the environment.

The mesh that breathes Breathable mesh is used on both the backrest and the seat. This choice ensures long-lasting comfort and prevents overheating, even during many hours at the desk. Beyond temperature control, the tension of the mesh backrest adapts naturally to the curve of the spine, providing tailored support.

Tilt mechanism The integrated Tilt mechanism allows for smooth and effortless adjustment of the recline angle. This feature gives the freedom to rock gently in the chair, adapting the position precisely to current needs. It is a solution that offers comfort, whether during intensive work or a moment of rest.

Armrests for enhanced comfort The integrated armrests deliver consistently stable support, and their unique shape has been meticulously engineered. This careful design ensures the armrests perfectly align with the natural resting position of your arms, guaranteeing a high level of convenience and exceptional comfort during use.

name: Aplo
sourceDescription:
Aplo. Apply your concept Every space requires different options. The Aplo shelving system is a smart, modular line that empowers you to design your own furniture for your office. By combining open shelves with storage units, felt panels, flowerpots and accessories, you can create a functional office environment that truly reflects individual needs and preferences. Designer RainlightSTUDIO Flexible and modular design Multiple filling options: cabinets, shelves, lockers, drawers or even flower pots Felt U-shaped panels for shelves for a warmer, cosier look Wide palette of melamine, metal and felt finishes Perfect solution for storing, decorating and dividing spaces

CLICK SYSTEM The technology of fixing crossbars to the frame clicks together in seconds which makes assembly quick, easy and fully reversible. That allows to change Aplo layout at any time. The solution is currently patent pending.

RANGE OF MODULES Each Aplo element is available in two widths: 360 mm and 760 mm, allowing columns of different width (400 and 800 mm) to be mixed and matched to create layouts that are both highly functional and visually appealing. Hinged-door cabinets and lockers are available in heights of 1, 2, and 3 OH, providing enough space for documents and other items that need to be neatly stored out of sight. Other storage elements, such as open cabinets and drawers, are available in a single height of 1 OH. The flowerpot occupies one full unit of 1 OH, however, the container itself is only 0,5 OH in height. The remaining half of the unit is intended for the plant growth.

SHELF • serves as the basic unit that forms Aplo system • can be placed on any level from 1 to 6 • each shelf can be fitted with a U-shaped felt panel • shelves on levels 5 and 6 are equipped with a plastic profile for hanging a whiteboard OPEN CABINET • storage boxes without fronts • can be placed on levels from 1 to 4 DRAWERS • fitted with horizontal metal handles • can be placed on level 1 or 2 LOCKER CABINET • fitted with a lock and horizontal metal handle • can be placed on levels from 1 to 4 • if the locker’s height is 3 OH, it occupies levels 1-2-3 or 2-3-4 HINGED-DOOR CABINET • fitted with vertical metal handle, no lock • can be placed on levels from 1 to 4 • cabinets of height 2 and 3 OH are equipped with internal shelf • if the cabinet’s height is 3 OH it occupies levels 1-2-3 or 2-3-4 FLOWERPOT • fitted with plastic inserts • can be placed on any level from 1 to 6

USEFUL HINT Elements with a carcass: open cabinets, drawers, lockers and hinged-door cabinets, must not be positioned directly one above another. At least one empty space is required between them.

Need help configuring Aplo? Click the button below to access additional resources. Aplo Guide

Accessories - use them to shape Aplo your way!

Connect two Aplo sets together in one layout by use of: • 90° corner shelves that create angular composition. Corner shelves are available in 3 shapes: square, slanted, rounded • rectangular shelves to create linear layouts Both types of connecting shelves can join two Aplo sets of the same or different heights. Turn Aplo into a functional wardrobe module with a rail: • fixed directly to the shelf • suitable for 800 mm columns

Aplo cabinets build a cosy, semi-private workspace. Equipped with a whiteboard or felt back panel, they become less transparent yet even more functional by supporting everyday collaboration without losing their open character.

Felt back panel • tool-free assembly • applicable to columns of 400 and 800 mm width • felt back panel can be fitted only if the Aplo cabinet contains 2, 3 or 4 shelves placed directly one under another in one column Whiteboard • possible to hang only on shelf with plastic profile, placed on level 5 or 6 • applicable to columns of 800 mm width

Aplo is a solution that can but doesn’t need to stand against the wall. Its double-sided layout turns it into a decorative highlight, looking great from every perspective. The high variants of Aplo are best to use as room partition without loosing the feel of a common space. Due to Aplo's remarkable stability, it is a safe free standing furniture solution.

Designer spotlight RainlightSTUDIO Yorgo Lykouria is an award-winning designer and the founder of Rainlight Studio, a renowned multi-disciplinary design studio based in London. For more than 20 years Yorgo has created artefacts that inspire people to live imaginatively and courageously in the present. With an extensive career in architecture, interiors and industrial design - across continents and cultures - Yorgo brings an expansive, holistic perspective to any design challenge. Yorgo has gained international recognition for his innovative and human-centric approach to design, creating spaces and artefacts that blend beauty, functionality, and sustainability.

"Aplo is a system that allows to modulate space with various functional components. The screening elements bring not only a sense of colour and the visual accent but also privacy to the work experience. Aplo, with its reduced visual, brings structural clarity to your ecosystem and makes your space your very own." - designer of Aplo, Yorgo Lykouria

Cabinets with doors, drawers, and lockers let you hide belongings you want to keep safe and out of sight. Shelves, on the other hand, showcase beautiful items that decorate and warm up the room. The metal frame and melamine-faced fronts are perfectly flush, which creates a clean and elegant look of the whole piece of furniture.

ECO DESIGN The Aplo line is developed in accordance with the ecodesign management principles of the ISO 14006:2020 standard. As a result, Aplo achieves good environmental performance: - 25–30% of its total material content is recycled - over 90% of the product is recyclable

name: Colani
sourceDescription:
In 1968, when the paths of the great designer Luigi Colani and the innovation-oriented manufacturer Kusch+Co crossed, the Colani collection – embracing both the armchair and the chaise longue – was brought to life. That very special connection gave rise to a design classic that gained worldwide acclaim and still wins the hearts of open-minded people today.

Definition of modern cosiness

The iconic Colani soft seating collection is recognized for its ergonomic design and exceptional comfort. Appealing with its unique organic form, Colani still holds the same fascination today as it did back then. The fluid lines, highlighted by bold colours, create a vibrant atmosphere in spaces that long to captivate at first sight.

Colani collection blurs the boundary between furniture and art Gaining worldwide recognition, this iconic furniture has proven to be a perfect fit especially for relaxation areas, lobbies and lounge zones – including those at airports. Its vibrant, flowing, organic lines provide a remarkable contrast to contemporary glass, steel, and concrete structures. Colani collection blurs the boundary between furniture and art

Designer spotlight Luigi Colani Prof. Luigi Colani, born in 1928, initially studied sculpture and painting at the Berlin University of the Arts in Berlin, before he completed his studies in Aerodynamics at the Sorbonne, the former University of Paris. Subsequently, he emigrated to California where he headed the materials research department. In the 1950s, Colani returned to Europa, and created his idiosyncratic, aerodynamic and biomorph designs for automotive manufacturers.At the end of the 1960s, he held a tenure at Kusch+Co, developing a range of creative seating series. In the early 1990s, he moved to Asia, and began commuting between his atelier in Karlsruhe and countries such as China or Japan, the cradle of some of his most famous successes. Until his demise in September 2019, this acclaimed designer operated on a global level.

Every detail of K42 is focused on both functionality and design.

Available in three widths and featuring the same range of handles as other K42 elements, it’s a truly versatile solution that fits smartly every office layout.

name: Kanu
sourceDescription:
Kanu is a series of distinctive, moulded plywood lounge armchairs. Designed for use in lounges, offices, public and domestic interiors.

Consistency of design At a certain point in the design process, the idea that the entire armchair, including the base, should be made of plywood, cropped up. The Kanu base was therefore cut from flat plywood and given a specific edge radius. The use of the same material was the result of a certain logic and consistency in this product. The result of the work on the base is the wide, sloping legs. To give the chair depth and elegance, it was decided to paint the base black. Thanks to this treatment, we see a beautiful interplay of light when we look at Kanu. The light reflected on the surface of the legs is almost architectural, it enhances the shape and makes the whole armchair more dynamic.

“Designing the Kanu armchair was thoroughly inspiring. In theory it is said that it is best to design without constraints, which is not true, because you do not know what the reference points are. In the case of the Kanu, that point was rectangular plywood, bent in one plane with a radius of 500 mm. That is where everything started. Everything else is the result of subsequent decisions to create the product in the most logical way possible. Hence the idea of designing a range of seats with such an amazing shape.” Tomasz Augustyniak designer

Kanu lounge armchairs are all about variety In keeping with current trends, there is also a version of the Kanu armchair on a metal base. Visually light with an industrial character. This interesting design alternative makes the armchair a striking design element in a variety of interiors. As well as different frames, it has two different backrests – a fully elliptical one and one with a beautifully undercut arch. Kanu can also feature an upholstered pad, not only on the seat, but also on the backrest. It is an appealing armchair in different guises. Kanu offers an impressive range of options in various styles. Kanu lounge armchairs are all about variety

1 / 2 Sileo Levels Sileo Levels line have been designed as a result of a research project carried out by our team of acoustic engineers. The main purpose of these panels is to facilitate optimal acoustic conditions in rooms with different finishes. Typical upholstered acoustic panels can effectively absorb a limited range of frequencies, and they can actually make an existing problem even worse in some cases. Compared to existing solutions, perforated panels can be used to better match the sound absorption range to the specific problem occurring in a particular space. Sileo Levels With three different thicknesses, the panels can be used to create interesting spatial forms which expand the arrangement potential, while ensuring the right absorption characteristics for offices. As a result, the Treble panel is the most effective for high frequency tones, the Middle panel for medium frequency, and the Bass panel for low frequency tones. A combination of the three panels in the right proportions offers sound absorption for a wide range of frequencies, which is recommended for spaces fitted with hardly any other absorbing materials, such as carpets or acoustic ceilings.
